infusable.description: False means Standard is the only affinity this weapon has, and the ranking is one row long.

best.description: The highest-damage affinity. A postcondition ties this to the maximum of `ranked`.

runner_up.description: Second place, or empty when there is only one affinity.

best_margin.description: How far the best beats the runner-up. A small margin means the choice is close and should be reported as close, not as a winner.

ranked.description: Every affinity this weapon can take, best first. Affinities it cannot take are absent, not zero.

target.description: Whether these numbers are against the calculator's standard PvE reference or defences the caller supplied. Say which; the same weapon ranks differently against different enemies.

damage.description: Damage actually dealt to the target, after its defences and absorptions.

total_ap.description: Attack rating before the target is considered.
